purpose: Sanity-test 12-component reward stack against known exploits

probes.label: invalid_smiles_gaming_validity
probes.rationale: RDKit-unparseable should fail validity; downstream components return 0.
probes.test_method: Run all 12 reward components; verify expected_kill ones return ≤ 0.3 and expected_high ones return ≥ 0.7. If any expected_kill returns > 0.5, the reward stack is being gamed.
